overview: Ivory Coast, also called Côte d'Ivoire, is a country in West Africa, on the Gulf of Guinea. Its official capital is Yamoussoukro, while Abidjan is its largest city and economic centre. It became independent from France in 1960. French is the official language, and Ivory Coast is the world's largest producer of cocoa.

geography.text: The south of Ivory Coast has a coastline of lagoons and beaches, with tropical rainforest inland. Further north the land becomes savanna on a gently rising plateau. The west is hillier, rising to Mount Nimba on the border with Guinea and Liberia.
